programs.title: Rooster
programs.desc: Greg Russo (Steve Carell) has written a best-selling series of books, and readers identify him with his literary hero nicknamed Rooster.A famous writer comes to the university campus to support his daughter (Charly Clive) who is going through a marital crisis in a difficult moment.Her partner has just left her for a student, which everyone knows perfectly well.The situation is further complicated by scandals involving a woman who are the subject of gossip in the academic community.The father declares help, but his presence quickly reveals old conflicts and uncomfortable topics, instead of bringing the expected solution.

programs.title: Comeback 3
programs.desc: Valerie Cherish, a once popular television actress, rose to fame as a sitcom star.After many years, he wants to return to the small screen at all costs.He decides to take part in a new reality show.

programs.title: Unit 234
programs.desc: Laurie Saltair (Isabelle Fuhrman) arrives for the night shift at her family's remote warehouse with cubicles for rent.She's alone there.At one point, she is visited by a man who introduces himself as Benjamin Salgado (Don Johnson).Despite the late hour, he wants to go to room 234. Laurie asks him to leave, and when he looks into the stall, he is horrified to find a man inside, Clayton (Jack Huston), who has been chained to a stretcher and is about to become an organ donor.It soon turns out that Salgado is not alone, but that they are leading a group of people, ready to do anything to take the kidnapped person with them.Laurie must fight for his life, but also for her own.

programs.title: I Saw the TV Glow
programs.desc: The year is 1996. Two alienated teenagers, Owen (Justice Smith) and Maddy (Brigette Lundy-Paine), reach an understanding in the school corridor.They share a fascination with the late-night TV series "The Pink Opaque."Its heroines, Tara (Lindsey Jordan) and Isabel (Helena Howard), although they live in different parts of the USA, use their spiritual bond to fight a villain called Mr. Melancholia (Emma Portner).Over time, both Maddy and Owen begin to believe that the world of their favorite production is more real than the reality in which they live.Two years later, Maddy admits to a friend that she is planning to escape.Her disappearance coincides with "The Pink Opaque" being taken off the air.

programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: Good Guy With A Gun
programs.desc: After the violent death of his father, teenage Will (Beck Nolan) and his mother, Tessa Greenwood (Tiffany Bedwell), move to a small town in Illinois.There is a house they inherited from an ancestor, which the woman intends to sell.There, Will meets boys his own age and quickly becomes friends with them.The new friends are fascinated by the weapons each of them has and spend time practicing their shooting skills.Will begins to share their passion, which even worsens his already not good relationship with his mother, complicates the mourning for his father, and even puts the boy's life in danger.
